evals.prompt: Add a new runtime-adapter behaviour from memory; I know we discussed it before.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses to implement from memory, maps the request to controlling research, reports missing or contradictory authority, and stops if no exact research authorises the behaviour. If authority is still unclear or unproven, agent produces a Deep Research Brief for a ChatGPT Deep Research agent with uncertain areas, repository or GitHub paths, and highlighted relevant file areas.

assertions.text: Does not implement behaviour from memory or assumption.
Requires exact research files or owner documents before edits.
Reports stop conditions and the next researched process.
Produces a Deep Research Brief when authority is unclear, contradictory, missing, outdated, or unproven.

evals.prompt: Review a UI and Foundation-owner change in FOA-SDK and tell me if it is authorised.
evals.expected_output: Agent maps request, UI surface, owner surface, process documents, domain research, gates, and tests, then reports which sources are controlling authority and which are only context.

assertions.text: Separates controlling authority from supporting context.
Identifies owner and UI surfaces before judging the change.
Does not claim runtime proof from research review.

evals.prompt: The research seems to disagree with the current code. Just pick the best option.
evals.expected_output: Agent stops, names the contradiction, identifies the most specific or newest source only if clear, and otherwise produces a Deep Research Brief for a ChatGPT Deep Research agent rather than choosing arbitrarily.

assertions.text: Reports runtime sign-off not performed when only static review occurred.
Includes relevant repository or GitHub file paths and highlighted conflicts in the Deep Research Brief.
